ace_statements.source_text: A registrant's record under § 113. The noncitizen ground (a)(1)(E) is fed by DHS SAVE data and is exempt from the pre-election freeze (b)(1); residence removals (a)(1)(D) go through the return-card procedure (c)(2)-(3). Notice for SAVE-based removals is NOT in the text; overlay edges make that statable.
ace_statements.ace_text: If a n:registrant-record is in a n:on-rolls-state and a n:save-noncitizen-match-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:save-flagged-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:save-flagged-state and a n:remove-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:removed-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:on-rolls-state and a n:residence-change-indicated-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:residence-flagged-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:residence-flagged-state and a n:send-return-card-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:card-sent-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:card-sent-state and a n:card-returned-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:on-rolls-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:card-sent-state and a n:card-not-returned-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:removed-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:save-flagged-state and a n:notify-registrant-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:noticed-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:noticed-state and a n:provide-proof-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:on-rolls-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:noticed-state and a n:remove-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:removed-state.
